ARC250: Arcadian Nightstand
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-arc250-arcadian-nightstand
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/arcadian-nightstand/
Spec sheets: ARC250 Arcadian Nightstand, Arcadian Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Arcadian Molded Nightstand – ARC250
Current H1: Norix Arcadian Durable Nightstand - ARC250
Subtitle: One-Piece Ligature-Resistant Bedside Nightstand with Two Open Cubbies for Behavioral Health Patient Rooms
Current subtitle: Norix ARC250 Arcadian Molded Nightstand for Behavioral Health Facilities
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Arcadian Nightstand is a one-piece, rotationally molded bedside table for behavioral health patient rooms, with two open cubbies for books and personal items. It brings a residential look to the room with the durability of high-impact polyethylene. The seamless design has no internal openings, pass-throughs, or tie-off points, which reduces ligature risk.
Inverted internal support ribs give the nightstand its strength without interior foam, and concealed, tamper-resistant hardware anchors it to the floor. For extra weight, it can be ballasted at the factory with up to 35 lbs of dry sand. The slightly textured surface can be cleaned with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants.
Construction: One-piece, rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with no internal openings
Support: Inverted internal support ribs for strength, with no interior foam
Surface: Slightly textured surface for long-term, maintenance-free performance
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Storage: Two open cubbies, 0.82 cu. ft. (top) and 1.4 cu. ft. (bottom)
Overall Size: 20”W×20”D×23”H
Weight: 28 lbs
Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sage, Sand, Sienna, or Dove
Static Load Testing: Tested to 750 lbs
Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletins 133, 117, and 116; ASTM E1537; NFPA 261
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for routine cleaning; bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16 can be used per the manufacturer’s instructions
Warranty: Lifetime warranty
Recyclable: 100% recyclable
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
ARC250 – Arcadian Nightstand: 20”W×20”D×23”H, 28 lbs
Factory Ballasting: Optional factory ballasting with up to 35 lbs of dry sand, with removable glides; must be specified when ordering, as the nightstand cannot be ballasted in the field
Installation and Options
Bolt-Down: Bolt-down kit required for floor anchoring. The Norix anchoring system uses concealed hardware and is intended for concrete floors and/or walls
Security Caulk: May be applied around the perimeter after anchoring
Assembly: None required
[H2] Applications
The Norix Arcadian Nightstand suits patient rooms where residents need a safe bedside table with open, easy-to-check storage.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers
Rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Arcadian Bedroom Furniture
The Norix Arcadian Series brings a residential look to behavioral health patient rooms, with furniture rotationally molded from a specially formulated, high-impact polyethylene that stands up to intensive use.
Common characteristics of Arcadian furniture include:
Ligature Resistant Design: One-piece, seamless construction eliminates pass-throughs and tie-offs
Concealed Hardware: Floor anchoring with concealed, tamper-resistant hardware
Contraband Resistant: No creases or nooks to hide contraband when bolted down
Infection Control: Seamless surfaces are impervious to fluids and can be cleaned with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants
Inverted Support Ribs: Internal ribs add strength without interior foam
Environmentally Responsible: Every piece is 100% recyclable
The Arcadian Series includes a platform bed, nightstand, floor-mount desk, open chest, two shelf units, and wardrobes with or without a molded door.
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Arcadian Bedroom Furniture" section as the ARC100 tab.
PRICE: the live page shows $0.00 with no compare-at price. The Norix April 2026 price list says $775. Andrew's note on the ARC100 tab ("Please make price correction for any or all of the Arcadian products") covers this: $620.00 (compare-at $775).
Factory ballasting: the price list shows the ballasting option at $84 (list). It is mentioned in the text but is not a variant on our page. Would you like a ballasted variant? If yes, please give me the SKU.
Bolt-down kit: the Norix web page lists only factory ballasting as an option, but the spec sheet says the bolt-down kit is required for floor anchoring. I used the spec sheet and kept it vague, as on the ARC100 page.
Removed from the current page: "Raised outer edges keep fluids contained and a gently crowned top allows fluids to drain towards the corners." This is from the Arcadian Bed and is not on the nightstand spec sheet.
Warranty, static load, and flammability: the current page has none of these. The Norix spec sheet says lifetime warranty, 750 lbs static load, and CAL TB133, TB117, TB116, ASTM E1537, and NFPA 261, so I added them.
Weight, size, and cubby volumes match the spec sheet, the price list, and the worksheet (row 184: 28 / 20 / 20 / 23).
Images: the 4 current images are kept (Cove, Sand, Sienna, and the color chart, no alt text). Norix also has photos in Twilight, Sage, and Dove (600×600). Would you like me to add them as "Norix-Arcadian-Nightstand-ARC250-Twilight.jpg," "-Sage.jpg," and "-Dove.jpg"?
Collections: the nightstand is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Norix Furniture.
Removed: the "advantages" list (now covered by the series section) and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph.
